Rain on Rama IX

The water came up the soi at four; by six it had reached the shrine — not the first time, and not, I suspect, the last. We moved the motorbikes; we moved the rice; we argued about the cat.

❦

What we needed was simple: a map that told us which gauge had crossed the bank, and when. Nobody needed a dashboard with twelve cards; we needed one number, next to one place.

  • 🌧️ the rain, which did not care
  • 🚤 the neighbour's boat, which did
